name: websiteinnovator.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But the content security policy has gaps.
lesson: Tighten the content security policy one directive at a time, starting from default-src 'self'.
summary: www.websiteinnovator.com scores 89 out of 100 (B). 0 checks fail now, 16 are at risk, and 42 pass. Fix first: tracking starts on load and no banner asks first.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Analytics (2 requests), and cookies _ga_1L5MVW2BSX, _ga.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Consent Mode default grants analytics before a choice
fix.evidence: gtag consent default sets analytics_storage to granted.
fix.fix: Default every storage type to denied and add ad_user_data and ad_personalization.

fix.title: The content security policy has gaps
fix.fix: Replace 'unsafe-inline' with nonces or hashes, limit hosts, and add object-src 'none' and base-uri 'self'.

fix.title: 6 images are more than twice the size shown
fix.evidence: howard-county-lhic-desktop.webp on /portfolio/ (1440×900 shown at 175×109, 149 KB, about 140 KB to save), rose-hanbok-desktop.webp on /portfolio/ (1440×900 shown at 175×109, 81 KB, about 76 KB to save), bbcc-burning-bush-counseling-center-des… on /portfolio/…
fix.fix: Resize images to at most twice the width they are shown at, and give phones smaller files with srcset and sizes.

fix.title: 1 title runs past about 60 characters
fix.evidence: /services/ai-visibility/ (88). Google cuts them with an ellipsis.
fix.fix: Lead with the words that matter and keep titles near 60 characters.

fix.title: llms.txt exists but lacks Markdown [title](url) links
fix.fix: Follow the llmstxt.org layout: # name, > summary, then ## sections of [title](url): note.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 161 ms
Every external link that was checked answered
